content:
maya: Quick sync — console per-route compact quickfilters + routing hints. Need a decision on: 1) saved-query semantics (should it bind to route + model or be route-agnostic?), 2) cost preview/quota exposure in the save flow, 3) telemetry sampling attachment. Short thread pls.

jake: I'm leaning route-scoped with optional model pin. saves that leak across routes caused confusion last time :grimacing:

li: backend note: if route-scoped then schema is tiny: {"route_id":"r-123","filters":...,"model_pin":null,"sample_rate":0.1}

sam: telemetry: we should attach sample_rate to saved query so evals and regression checks use same sampling. otherwise metrics mismatch when users re-run.

maya: good point. UX question — show cost estimate inline vs. a lightweight badge? we don't want the save modal to feel heavy.

jake: compact badge is fine. hover shows estimate, clicking expands cost breakdown. keeps modal < 5 fields.

li: API contract proposal:
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "name":"High-latency-errors",
  "route_id":"r-123",
  "filters": {"status":["5xx"], "latency_ms":{"gt":200}},
  "model_pin":"m-v1.2-q8",
  "sample_rate":0.05,
  "visibility":"team"
}
```
Response 201 with id and cost_estimate.

sam: cost_estimate should be derived server-side using route telemetry model (p95 seq len, tokens/req). front-end can request `?preview=true` during draft.

maya: rollout plan idea: feature flag per-org, A/B so half see inline badge+hover, half see modal cost preview. Collect metrics: save rate, clickthrough, support tickets.

jake: UI caveat — autosave drafts: we shouldn't persist ephemeral sample_rate unless user explicitly toggles it. otherwise clones cause weirdness.

li: agreed. default sample_rate = route default if unset. API shall distinguish null vs explicit 0.

devbot: deploy scheduled: feature/saved-query-api in staging -> 4470001140 :rocket:

ops-bot: gating rule: roll forward if error-rate < 0.5% and median latency < 150ms for 24h, otherwise rollback.

maya: next steps: li to finalize API shape, jake to ship mock with hover badge, sam to sketch telemetry join keys. I'll schedule a quick review friday. @li @jake @sam :thumbsup:

li: will send PR with schema and migration notes.

jake: starting mock now, will ping for review when interactive.

sam: will add an integration test spec for sampling consistency.

maya: thanks all — short and actionable. closing thread.
